title: repair_check: do not fail the job when the merge request names no issue
notes: grep exits 1 with no match and GitLab runs jobs with pipefail, so the job failed on Duo merge requests without Closes #N; request_fix then asked Duo to repair a defect that is not in its code (sessions 10030034 and 10030043). Touches .gitlab-ci.yml: opened with the human's token.
